task: HADDOCK3-style integrative modeling of barnase-barstar (1BRS) and validation against SKEMPI 2.0
named_methods_required: HADDOCK water-stage scoring function (linear combination of E_vdw, E_elec, E_AIR, E_desolv)
Rigid-body sampling + clustering as in HADDOCK protocol
Validation against SKEMPI 2.0 experimental binding affinity changes upon mutation
primary_quantitative_targets: Top-ranked docking poses with HADDOCK score
Cluster sizes, ranks, mean scores, best-of-cluster
Interface RMSD vs reference 1BRS_AD bound complex
Spearman/Pearson correlation between per-residue HADDOCK-style interface energies and SKEMPI ddG
deviations_from_named_method: HADDOCK3 itself relies on CNS (closed-source, not installable in this sandbox). Implementation is a faithful Python re-implementation of the AIR-driven rigid-body sampling + HADDOCK water-stage scoring rather than the canonical haddock3 binary.
Force field parameters approximated with Lennard-Jones using OPLS-style atomic radii and partial charges from a small lookup table; HADDOCK uses full OPLSx parameters.
deliverables: outputs/: AIR table, pose tables, cluster table, SKEMPI validation table
report/images/: data overview, AIR map, score-RMSD funnel, predicted vs reference interface, SKEMPI validation
report/report.md: full methodology, results, validation, discussion
